techStack.app: SwiftUI iOS app with Firebase Auth, Firestore, Storage, Messaging
techStack.backend: Firebase Cloud Functions (Node.js 22, firebase-functions v6, firebase-admin v12)

notableSubsystems: push notification routing + unread count sync
widget via App Group shared defaults

patterns: offline-first listeners load disk cache before attaching Firestore snapshot listeners
MainTabView starts listeners in staggered phases to reduce launch cost
HomeViewModel throttles merged objectWillChange publishers to reduce redraw storms

notes: README exists but project setup still depends on local Firebase plist and Firebase rules paths
firebase.json points to missing rules files under sevgilim/firebase/

notes.content: Broad consumer app for couples: auth + partner invitation, memories, photos/videos, notes, plans, songs via Spotify search, movies, places, chat with typing/reactions/delete scopes, stories, moods, surprises, secret vault, special days, notifications, proximity, widget day counter.

Cloud Functions file is monolithic (~3.1k LOC) and owns 28 triggers/endpoints including push fanout, unread notification count sync, creation/update triggers, scheduled reminders for plans/special days/surprises/memory flashbacks/inactive couple nudges.
Security smell: Spotify client id and client secret are embedded in sevgilim/Info.plist and consumed by SpotifyService fallback; secrets should not live in client bundle.

Repo hygiene issues: root contains a second legacy index.js for functions, tracked build artifacts/build and functions/node_modules, multiple .DS_Store files, and firebase.json references missing Firestore/Storage rules files.

Test suite is partial and stale: only 8 Swift test files, mixed XCTest and Swift Testing styles, and TestDataFactory.makeMemory still calls Memory initializer with removed photoURL parameter, indicating tests may not be runnable without cleanup.

Firestore index coverage appears incomplete: firestore.indexes.json defines only one composite index while MessageService explicitly falls back when ordered message query hits failedPrecondition due to missing index.
